summary: JBDI Holdings, a Cayman Islands-incorporated metal drum maker listed on the Nasdaq Capital Market, filed a Form 6-K disclosing its election to rely on the home country rule exemption under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5615(a)(3). The company will follow Cayman Islands practice in lieu of Nasdaq Rule 5635, which otherwise requires shareholder approval for acquisitions of stock or assets, equity-based compensation, changes of control, and non-public-offering transactions. Cayman counsel Harney Westwood Riegels provided the required certification to Nasdaq. No transaction, terms, or special-situation event is disclosed; this is a routine foreign-private-issuer governance notice.
